research_question: To what extent does transfer learning improve satellite-image classification, and how do pretraining pathways influence classification performance and spatial generalization?

so2sat_split.limitation: Official validation and testing partitions cover the same ten named cities in geographically separated halves; this is not unseen-city generalization.

sentinel2.normalization_note: Pragmatic consistent convention; not established as optimal for reflectance data.

experiments.M3: ImageNet → EuroSAT pretraining, frozen backbone during So2Sat training
experiments.M4: ImageNet → EuroSAT pretraining, full fine-tuning during So2Sat training

pretraining_provenance.M3: ResNet-18 initialized with ImageNet-pretrained weights, then pretrained on EuroSAT; transferred to So2Sat with the backbone frozen.
pretraining_provenance.M4: ResNet-18 initialized with ImageNet-pretrained weights, then pretrained on EuroSAT; transferred to So2Sat with full fine-tuning.

spatial_generalization_audit.interpretation: Internal validation samples are substantially more spatially associated with training samples than official test samples. Spatial dependence may contribute to the validation-to-test performance gap; this analysis does not establish causation.
